ValueSet: Radiology Findings Value Set

Official URL: https://core.fhir.health.gov.fj/ValueSet/fiji-radiology-findings-vs Version: 0.9.1
Active as of 2026-11-27 Computable Name: FijiRadiologyFindingsVS
Other Identifiers: OID:2.16.840.1.113883.4.642.40.1005.48.18

Copyright/Legal: Distributed under the Creative Commons CC0-1.0 License (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)

Fiji radiology findings including SNOMED CT concepts filtered for radiology and imaging findings used within an IPS context.

References

  • Fiji Diagnostic Observation
  • Fiji Imaging Diagnostic Report

Logical Definition (CLD)

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where constraint = << 365853002
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where constraint = < 118247008

 

Expansion

Expansion from tx.fhir.org based on SNOMED CT International edition 01-Jul 2026

This expansion is not closed: there are codes in the value set that are not included in the expansion

This value set contains 882 concepts

Explanation of the columns that may appear on this page:

Level A few code lists that FHIR defines are hierarchical - each code is assigned a level. In this scheme, some codes are under other codes, and imply that the code they are under also applies
System The source of the definition of the code (when the value set draws in codes defined elsewhere)
Code The code (used as the code in the resource instance)
Display The display (used in the display element of a Coding). If there is no display, implementers should not simply display the code, but map the concept into their application
Definition An explanation of the meaning of the concept
Comments Additional notes about how to use the code
